# Billboardbug MCP

> MCP server that lets AI agents publish a business's deal as a GPS-anchored billboard in the Billboardbug apps (iOS, Android, web, Meta Quest) and post a chirp about it, with read-back.

Server: build/index.js (TypeScript, 11 tools). Legacy mcp/server.mjs is not used by any launcher.
Install: git clone https://github.com/bgaut007/billboardbug-mcp ; npm ci ; npm run build ; set BILLBOARDBUG_API_KEY ; run node build/index.js as stdio MCP. Not on npm yet.

Tools: create_deal, update_deal, get_deal, list_my_deals, list_categories, search_deals, upload_media, generate_image, create_chirp, update_chirp, get_chirp

Skills: skills/billboardbug (1.2.3), skills/billboardbug-deal-creator (1.1.3)

API docs: https://east-us-api.billboardbug.com/public-api/docs/
OpenAPI: https://east-us-api.billboardbug.com/public-api/spec
Platform: https://billboardbug.com
